title: Writer: Elijah Kalista
article: Elijah is an energetic ten year old, born in NYU hospital in Manhattan. He enjoys playing games, reading and writing. He came to Senesh in second grade, and before that he went to BFS. His main hobby is running, but he also enjoys creating animations. He thinks (very) dark thoughts, but tries (and fails) to be positive. The strange 5th grader plans to be an Olympic track racer and start a business. He recently went to Legoland California Resort and visited Texas.
author: Elijah Kalista
